owner_cash_impact: Recurring acquisition cash, integration, amortization, debt and dilution may exceed reported EPS benefit

owner_cash_impact: Quality, cyber and regulatory claims are senior to common-owner cash

evidence_object: share compensation and diluted owner claim
unresolved_question: Is SBC offset by true excess cash or only by repurchases/debt?

owner_cash_impact: A reported cash residual must be reduced or qualified for recurring equity compensation

observable_in_artifact: Systems, instruments/accessories, services and procedure disclosures

owner_cash_impact: The reported residual is qualified until inventory normalization and per-share cash are shown

observable_in_artifact: Receivables, inventory, payables and provider-credit disclosures
